limitations: Four measured updates per arm on128 synthetic fit cases; only three later samples. First/later variation is reported, not confidence bounds or convergence evidence.
The profile repeatedly uses one64-case synthetic batch in one process. Full source/provenance scale and long-run thermal or storage behavior are unqualified.
No new backward or optimizer run isolates current H4 training-kernel cost; comparing old H2 kernel timing with H4 total update is not a model or GPU speed comparison.
Profile full prediction is used as a clean-inner proxy even though clean-inner additionally transforms labels/computes loss and has a different wrapper. Its error is unmeasured.
Qualification training timings include durable status serialization/writes around AdamW.step; profiling does not isolate that cost.
17requested scenario passes include mixed_recent_ridge, which correctly rejected the64-case synthetic batch with56admissible/8inadmissible. A complete17-pass scored panel is not qualified.
Ancillary ridge fits, fill construction on new cohorts, scoring/bootstrap, fullscale constructor/provenance memory, checkpoint growth and failures are not timed by these projections.
Small-profile augmented adapter being faster than clean is not evidence augmentation improves runtime; stage order/warmup and different masks are not controlled for such a claim.
The old proposal remains unchanged historical evidence; these estimates concern only the optional H4 sensitivity, not the primary180 fit scope or a cloud funding release.
